profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with experience across developer experience, cloud infrastructure, and machine learning. I design and build systems that streamline development workflows, improve reliability, and enable teams to deliver software at scale.

My work spans infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD automation, and cloud migrations, as well as building predictive models and data-driven applications. I enjoy bridging the gap between engineering and operations—creating tools that make complex systems easier to build, test, and maintain.
